module_dispositions.rationale: Horizontal packing measurement, glue setting, adjustment migration, and diagnostics.
Vertical packing, depth clamping, diagnostics, and baseline-aware list append.
Typed math fields, noads, choices, styles, display, and destruction invariants.
Style parameters, clean boxes, variable delimiters, fraction reboxing, mu glue, and math kern helpers.
Mlist recursion, field fetch, choice selection, bin normalization, and nonscript/mu conversion.
Rule, accent, fraction, operator, ligature, and script construction in the first pass.
Left/right construction, class spacing, style deletion, and math penalties in the second pass.
Prunes discardables and inserts adjusted split_top_skip before retained vertical material.
Selects a vertical breakpoint by TeX82 height, depth, glue-order, penalty, badness, and shrink recovery rules.
Splits a vbox, updates split marks, prunes/repackages the remainder, and handles void or wrong-kind registers.
Defines horizontal character, ligature/kern, language, and space insertion in the current list.
Defines direct rule/glue/kern material before the main-control shard's save-stack brace dispatch and restoration boundary; the same property separately owns §1070's post-unsave parameter clearing.
Clears group-reverting parameters after the save-stack restoration owned by the main-control shard.
Defines pack-spec scanning, box construction/register/shipout/leader continuations, shifts, copy/take/last/vsplit requests, group modes, hooks, and vtop adjustment.
Defines paragraph entry from vertical mode, indentation and everypar ordering, paragraph termination, and head-for-vmode recovery.
Defines insertion/adjustment/mark/penalty material, tail deletion, unboxing, italic correction, and mode restrictions.
Defines explicit and hyphen discretionary list construction plus text accent scanning and kern placement.
Inline/display entry, equation-number entry, paragraph interruption, and pre-display measurements.
Braced/unbraced math fields and base atom construction before scanner-owned delimiter sections.
Radical, accent, vcenter, style, and operator-limit request construction.
Four independently grouped mathchoice arms and ordered choice completion.
Subscript/superscript attachment, field collection, and duplicate-script recovery.
Defines generalized fraction state, optional delimiters and thickness, duplicate-fraction recovery, and left/right group completion/mismatch recovery.
Defines the only math exit, font validation, inline lowering, display/equation-number packing, spacing, and penalties before the alignment-owned display completion.

properties.claim: hpack measures each legal hlist node, migrates adjustment material, selects the highest stretch or shrink order and canonical ratio, and reports underfull/tight/overfull boxes without changing packed content.
preconditions: A finite hlist and live font, glue, hbadness and hfuzz state are available.
stimulus: Pack empty and mixed hlists under natural, to and spread requests with finite/infinite glue and adjustments.
expected_observations: Width, height, depth, glue sign/order/ratio, migrations and diagnostics follow §§644–667.
postconditions: The box owns nonmigrating nodes once and preserves their order.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary: natural versus equal resolved targets, exact fit, empty list, all glue orders, shifted children
recovery_cases: Normal over-shrink clamps and diagnoses; arithmetic overflow fails loudly.

properties.claim: vpackage measures vertical nodes, applies glue setting and diagnostics, clamps depth to max_depth, and append_to_vlist selects baseline_skip or line_skip from prev_depth before updating it.
preconditions: A finite vlist and live vertical packing and baseline parameters are available.
stimulus: Pack and append empty/mixed vlists at natural/exact/additional targets with depths around max_depth and baseline clearance.
expected_observations: Vertical dimensions, glue ratio, diagnostics, clamped depth and inserted interline glue follow §§668–679.
postconditions: The packed list is owned once and prev_depth equals the appended box/rule depth.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: exact fit, empty list, max_depth equality, leading glue, nested shifted boxes
recovery_cases: Infinite shrink and overfull/underfull states diagnose without reordering nodes.

properties.claim: Every TeX82 math node has the canonical field/noad/choice/style representation, initializes empty fields deterministically, displays recursively, and releases each owned field or mlist exactly once.
preconditions: Typed field and noad variants can represent every §34 layout.
stimulus: Construct, display and destroy every noad, choice arm, fraction field and nested mlist form.
expected_observations: Class, subtype, fields, delimiters, styles and four choice arms remain distinct.
postconditions: No field aliases mutable ownership and recursive release is complete.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: empty fields, all atom classes, null choices and deeply nested mlists
recovery_cases: Malformed internal variants are rejected structurally rather than interpreted as another noad.

properties.claim: Style selection supplies canonical font parameters; clean_box/rebox, overbar, variable-delimiter search and extensible assembly, mu-glue conversion and math-kern conversion produce style-correct boxes without losing field ownership.
preconditions: Math families, metrics, style and parameters are available.
stimulus: Clean empty/character/submlist fields, grow delimiters through variant and extensible chains, and convert mu glue/kerns in all styles.
expected_observations: Delimiter choice, assembly dimensions, reboxing, overbar and mu scaling follow §§699–718.
postconditions: Returned boxes are normalized and source fields are consumed once.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: null/small/large/extensible delimiters, empty fields, exact target extent and nested boxes
recovery_cases: Missing variants fall through both families to null delimiter space; missing characters do not corrupt adjacent material.

properties.claim: The first mlist pass recursively cleans fields, selects the current mathchoice arm, deletes style/choice wrappers, normalizes binary atoms from neighboring classes, and converts mu/nonscript nodes for the active style.
preconditions: A valid mlist and style enter the first pass.
stimulus: Process all atom-class neighborhoods, styles, choices, mu glue/kerns and nonscript markers.
expected_observations: Choice/style effects and bin normalization precede construction and spacing.
postconditions: No unresolved choice remains and each surviving noad has its final first-pass class.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: leading/trailing/consecutive bin atoms, cramped choices, deep choice nesting
recovery_cases: Undefined family characters diagnose locally while pass ordering and neighboring classes remain intact.

properties.claim: First-pass constructors implement rules, over/underlines, vcenters, accents, generalized fractions, operators and limits, math ligatures/kerns, and single/paired scripts with TeX82 style-dependent clearances and italic corrections.
preconditions: First-pass classes and cleaned fields plus live metrics/parameters are available.
stimulus: Construct every noad family in display/text/script styles with empty, character, box and submlist nuclei.
expected_observations: Accent skew/variant, fraction clearance, limit placement, lig/kern and script shifts match §§734–760.
postconditions: Each noad becomes one deterministic hlist fragment with no lost scripts or boxes.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: ruled/ruleless fractions, limits modes, sub-only/sup-only/pairs, empty nuclei and nested accents
recovery_cases: Missing glyphs/families omit only the unavailable glyph and preserve constructed siblings.

properties.claim: The second pass builds sized left/right delimiters, applies the canonical 8-by-8 atom-class spacing table with style suppression, removes style nodes, and inserts penalties only at eligible class boundaries.
preconditions: First-pass noad classes and constructed fragments are final.
stimulus: Traverse every class pair in all styles with left/right delimiters and penalty insertion enabled/disabled.
expected_observations: Spacing kind, delimiter extent and penalty placement follow §§761–767.
postconditions: The output hlist contains no noad/style wrapper and preserves source order.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: all class pairs, null delimiters, cramped scripts and nested left/right
recovery_cases: Unavailable delimiters use null delimiter space without suppressing adjacent spacing.

properties.claim: prune_page_top removes leading glue, kern and penalty nodes while preserving whatsits, marks and insertions, then inserts split_top_skip before the first box/rule with nonnegative width reduced by that node's height.
preconditions: A vertical list and split_top_skip are available.
stimulus: Prune lists with each discardable/preserved prefix and first box/rule heights below, equal to and above split_top_skip.
expected_observations: Only leading discardables are freed and adjusted top glue is inserted at the first box/rule.
postconditions: Preserved prefix order and remaining list ownership are unchanged.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: empty/all-discardable lists, marks before first box, equal/oversized height
recovery_cases: An impossible vertical-list node kind fails loudly instead of being discarded.

properties.claim: vert_break scans legal vertical breakpoints, tracks height/depth and glue orders, computes penalty-adjusted badness, prefers the latest equal-cost champion, stops at forced/awful breaks, and normalizes infinite shrink after diagnosing it.
preconditions: A legal vertical list, target height and max depth are available.
stimulus: Evaluate glue, kern-before-glue, penalty and forced breakpoints across stretch/shrink orders and depth limits.
expected_observations: Selected breakpoint and best_height_plus_depth match §§970–976.
postconditions: Only infinite-shrink normalization mutates the list; all other measurement is observational.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: exact fit, equal costs, null forced end, negative max depth and nested boxes
recovery_cases: Infinite shrink emits one diagnostic and becomes finite normal-order shrink before continuing.

properties.claim: vsplit clears prior split marks, rejects void/non-vbox registers canonically, selects and severs the best prefix, records first/bottom marks, prunes the remainder, replaces or voids the register, and exactly packages the extracted prefix.
preconditions: The scanned box register and target height are complete and split parameters are live.
stimulus: Split void, hbox and vbox registers at first, middle, artificial-end and penalty-first breaks with zero, one and multiple marks.
expected_observations: Extracted box, remainder register, split marks and dimensions follow §§977–979.
postconditions: Every node belongs to exactly one of extracted/remainder lists and register scope is preserved.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: exact/oversized target, complete extraction, penalty-first break and nested vboxes
recovery_cases: Void returns void; an hbox diagnoses and remains untouched.

properties.claim: Horizontal main control appends character and space material with TeX82 space-factor updates, boundary/ligature/kern processing, language whatsits, font-space caching, and xspace/xspaceskip scaling, while vertical-mode character material starts a paragraph and replays the triggering command.
preconditions: A current mode, font, language, space factor, sfcode table, and font lig/kern program are live.
Expanded-command entry is governed by tex82.main-control.mode-dispatch (§§1029–1031); this property owns the inner-loop setup and text-material actions beginning at §1032.
The current command is an ordinary character, char_given/char_num, spacer, or no_boundary dispatch.
stimulus: Deliver characters and spaces across font boundaries, ligature/kern instructions, boundary suppression, sfcode zero/low/high values, xspaceskip/space_skip/font glue choices, and vertical-mode paragraph entry.
expected_observations: Character nodes, ligatures, kerns and spaces are appended in source order and space_factor follows §1034 before glue scaling.
Vertical entry backs up the trigger, starts the paragraph, runs everypar, and then reprocesses it exactly once.
postconditions: The current hlist tail and space_factor describe precisely the delivered text; no raw input is read by the executor.
Cached font glue is copied before space-factor modification.
equivalence_cases: Positive: literal, char_given, and char_num characters share lig/kern and space-factor behavior.
Boundary: nullfont/missing glyph, sfcode 0/1000/>1000/<1000, boundary hit/miss, and xspaceskip present/absent.
Mode/nesting: outer vertical starts unrestricted hmode; restricted hmode stays restricted; math-mode text-only commands use recovery or their math meaning.
recovery_cases: A missing character emits the canonical warning and appends no character node.
A vertical-mode trigger survives paragraph-start backup with provenance and expansion order intact.

properties.claim: Rule, glue and kern commands scan complete typed operands before appending mode-appropriate nodes and invoke outer-vertical page building at the canonical boundary; after separately owned save-stack brace dispatch and restoration (§§1063–1069), §1070 clears the parameters whose values revert at group exit.
preconditions: Current mode/list and live glue or dimension parameters are available.
Command-owned scanners retain failed-keyword and rejected-opener backup ordering.
stimulus: Append h/v rules, skip and kern variants with zero, finite and infinite-order values in every legal mode.
expected_observations: Nodes carry the scanned value and subtype and outer vertical appends invoke page building at the canonical boundary.
Each complete scanner consumes only its own operand and preserves failed-keyword backup ordering.
postconditions: The current list owns each appended rule, glue, or kern exactly once.
No executor path re-reads a scalar operand.
equivalence_cases: Positive: named and explicit skip/kern forms with equal values append equivalent nodes.
Boundary: zero/negative dimensions, fil orders, omitted rule dimensions, and repeated keyword overrides.
Nesting/mode: rules, glue, and kerns append to the current outer/internal vertical, horizontal, or math list selected by canonical dispatch.
recovery_cases: A failed optional rule keyword backs up the first nonkeyword command for main control.
Cross-mode illegal and off-save recovery are non-owning dependencies on the main-control and group properties (§§1045–1054 and §§1063–1069) and scan no direct-material operand here.

properties.claim: Box requests complete packing-spec/open-brace scans command-side, enter the selected restricted-h/internal-v group and everybox hook, then package once on the matching close; box_end assigns, ships, leads, shifts, or appends the completed box, while box/copy/lastbox/vsplit preserve their destructive versus nondestructive register semantics and vtop resets height from its first item.
preconditions: The typed box continuation, effective assignment scope, mode, register bank, and packing parameters are retained through the body episode.
The mandatory opener has been consumed or canonically recovered before the executor enters the body.
stimulus: Construct empty/nested hbox, vbox, and vtop under natural/to/spread specs; target setbox/global setbox, shipout, leaders and signed shifts; use box/copy/lastbox/vsplit and invalid/missing operands in all legal and forbidden modes.
expected_observations: Packing specs and hooks run in TeX82 order, local body assignments restore on close, and the continuation receives exactly one completed box.
box empties its register, copy preserves it, lastbox removes only a legal tail box, vsplit returns the requested top and replaces the register with the remainder.
postconditions: Every active construction and save level is retired exactly once; register/global scope and aftergroup replay are preserved.
Appended/shifted/leader/shipout boxes retain packed children and dimensions without reopening input.
equivalence_cases: Positive: natural versus resolved-equal to/spread, brace aliases, nested hooks, and immediate/register box operands.
Boundary: void registers, box255, empty vtop, leading glue vtop, exact split, oversized split, and zero shifts.
Mode/nesting: hbox restricted hmode versus vbox/vtop internal vmode, nested simple groups, and illegal complementary shift modes.
recovery_cases: A missing opener backs up the rejected token as first body material; a missing box operand diagnoses and replays it.
lastbox in forbidden outer vertical/page state and invalid vsplit targets recover without stealing unrelated material.

properties.claim: new_graf enters unrestricted horizontal mode from vertical mode, resets paragraph state, optionally appends the indent box, runs everypar after mode entry, and backs up the triggering command; end_graf removes terminal glue, adds paragraph fill/penalty structure, line-breaks only nonempty unrestricted paragraphs, appends lines to the enclosing vlist, updates prev_graf, and invokes page building only at outer vertical depth.
preconditions: Vertical paragraph parameters, language/hyphen minima, everypar, parshape/hang settings, and line-breaking parameters are live.
Paragraph entry knows whether indentation is requested and whether the trigger must be replayed.
stimulus: Start indented/noindent/implicit paragraphs in outer and internal vertical mode, include empty and nonempty bodies with nested groups and migrating marks/inserts/adjustments, and terminate by par, vertical command, display math, or enclosing group close.
expected_observations: Mode/everypar/indent/trigger ordering matches §§1088–1091 and paragraph end constructs and breaks the exact current hlist.
Outer completion reaches the contribution/page builder; internal completion returns the lines to its enclosing list only.
postconditions: The paragraph hlist is consumed once, horizontal state resets, and the enclosing vertical mode receives ordered line boxes plus migrating material.
prev_graf and paragraph group scope are updated without leaking restricted-hmode bodies.
equivalence_cases: Positive: explicit indent/noindent and implicit character/unhbox/valign triggers.
Boundary: empty paragraph, only discardables, one line, terminal discretionary, and paragraph ending at group boundary.
Nesting/mode: paragraph inside vbox/insertion/output versus outer page; display interruption resumes vertical contribution correctly.
recovery_cases: head_for_vmode backs up the vertical command then a frozen par in unrestricted hmode; restricted hmode uses off_save.
A recovered triggering token retains provenance and runs only after everypar.

properties.claim: Insert, vadjust and mark groups freeze and append their typed material to the originating list; penalties append directly; delete-last removes only a matching legal tail; unbox/copy-unbox splice compatible box lists with the correct register destruction; and italic correction appends its font-derived kern only in legal h/math modes.
preconditions: The originating list/mode and relevant box/register/material parameters remain live across any nested construction.
Insertion class, mark text, penalty, delete subtype, unbox register and italic font metrics are completely scanned command-side.
stimulus: Build insert/vadjust/mark/penalty nodes in every legal mode, migrate them through boxes and paragraph lines, delete matching/nonmatching tails, unbox h/v boxes by move/copy, and request italic correction after characters, noncharacters, and in forbidden vertical mode.
expected_observations: Each node enters the current list in source order; migration preserves order and insert packaging snapshots the closing parameters.
Destructive operations change only their matching register/tail; copied operations preserve source ownership.
postconditions: Completed group bodies and box lists have one owner; page building is invoked only at the specified outer-vertical boundaries.
Forbidden or inapplicable operations leave unrelated list/register state unchanged.
equivalence_cases: Positive: mark/penalty in all modes, insert in outer/internal vertical and hmode, vadjust migration, unbox versus copy-unbox.
Boundary: insert classes 0/254/255/out-of-range, void/wrong-kind boxes, empty tails, zero italic correction.
Nesting/mode: structured material inside hbox and paragraph migrates outward; internal-vbox material remains owned by the box where required.
recovery_cases: insert255 and out-of-range classes diagnose/clamp as specified while vadjust's internal 255 sentinel remains legal.
Forbidden vadjust/unbox/italic/delete-last paths scan no extra operand beyond their canonical scanner boundary and preserve following input.

properties.claim: discretionary constructs exactly three live restricted-horizontal lists under disc_group, enforces the replacement-count limit and admissible node kinds, attaches pre/post/replacement ownership once, and preserves aftergroup replay; text accent scans the accent and optional base character, computes slant/x-height placement, appends balancing kerns, and replays a noncharacter base command.
preconditions: The discretionary command kind, current hmode, hyphen character, font metrics, and isolated group replay facility are available.
Accent scanning has a valid accent code or a recoverable noncharacter lookahead.
stimulus: Build explicit and automatic-hyphen discretionaries with empty/nonempty/nested parts and aftergroup effects; accent characters with and without bases, slanted fonts, missing glyphs, and noncharacter base commands.
expected_observations: Each discretionary part executes through live main control until its group closes and the final Disc node retains exact part order/provenance without changing space_factor.
Accent and base positioning/kerns match §1123 and a noncharacter base is backed up after the accent is appended.
postconditions: No part consumes parent material and all part-local groups/definitions are unsaved.
The final hlist owns each discretionary/accent node once and following input remains ordered.
equivalence_cases: Positive: discretionary shorthand and explicit empty groups; accent with ordinary and slanted fonts.
Boundary: 0/1/127/128 replacement nodes, empty branches, missing hyphen/accent/base glyphs, and zero skew.
Nesting/mode: discretionaries inside boxes/paragraphs and nested groups retain aftergroup and restricted-hmode ownership.
recovery_cases: Excess replacement nodes and forbidden node kinds are diagnosed and flushed according to §§1120–1121.
A noncharacter accent base is replayed exactly once; a missing mandatory discretionary brace follows frozen group recovery.

properties.claim: Math shift enters inline or display mode with correct shift lookahead, paragraph interruption, group/hook ordering, equation-number submode, and pre-display size/width computation.
preconditions: Horizontal mode, paragraph state, hooks and display parameters are live.
stimulus: Enter inline/display math from unrestricted/restricted hmode and start eqno/leqno under fitting and overfull pre-display material.
expected_observations: Mode/group transitions, everymath/everydisplay and paragraph break ordering follow §§1136–1149.
postconditions: One active math mlist owns the new mode and parent lookahead is preserved.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: single/double shifts, empty paragraph, restricted hbox and display after nested boxes
recovery_cases: eqno outside display is illegal and consumes no field; failed display pairing preserves lookahead.

properties.claim: Math fields classify one unbraced scalar in place or build a balanced braced sub-mlist with exact group ownership; scalar fields discard the math-code class nibble, while character and atom commands append the canonical noad class and typed nucleus.
preconditions: A live math mlist and command-owned scalar scanner or braced math-group boundary are available.
stimulus: Build empty, character, active, braced and nested fields for every atom command.
expected_observations: Field simplification and noad class/nucleus follow §§1150–1159.
postconditions: Each scalar field attaches once without an input transition; each braced field closes its live group before parent delivery.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: unbraced/braced equal fields, empty group, active outer character and nested subformula
recovery_cases: Missing brace backs up the rejected command and opens the field logically without fabricating delivery.

properties.claim: Radical, math-accent, vcenter, style and limit commands append their typed noad/node after completing required delimiter, character or field operands, with mode legality and accent misuse recovery.
preconditions: A live math list and completed typed request are available; delimiter scanning remains owned by §§1160–1161.
stimulus: Build radicals, accents, vcenters, every style and limits switch around character and compound nuclei.
expected_observations: Noad type, delimiter/accent value, style and limits subtype follow §§1162–1171.
postconditions: Each request appends once without rereading operands.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: delimiter 0/max, all styles, limits before/after operators and nested accent fields
recovery_cases: A non-math accent command diagnoses the required mathaccent spelling; wrong-mode requests use main-control recovery.

properties.claim: mathchoice collects display, text, script and scriptscript arms as four independent math groups in fixed order, restores style/group state between arms, and appends one choice node only after all four complete.
preconditions: A live math list can open four isolated replay groups.
stimulus: Build empty/nonempty/nested choices with local assignments and aftergroup material in each arm.
Committed `choice-groups` explicitly assigns tex.web §232 INITEX catcodes, observes one §1172 `math_choice` dispatch, and then projects the completed box after four §1174 branches.
expected_observations: Each arm freezes and retires independently in display-to-scriptscript order.
The primitive is dispatched once; `build_choices` advances through the four groups without redispatching `mathchoice`.
postconditions: One choice node owns four distinct mlists and no arm consumes parent input.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: empty arms, deep choices and choice inside alignment/script
recovery_cases: Missing arm braces recover at that arm only; premature parent input is not folded into a completed arm.

properties.claim: Subscript and superscript markers reserve the previous noad's empty field before scanning, synthesize an ordinary empty noad when no target exists, and diagnose then redirect duplicate same-kind scripts before scanning their fields.
preconditions: A live mlist and script-field replay boundary are available.
stimulus: Attach sub-only, sup-only and paired scripts to existing/absent nuclei, then repeat either marker with nested fields.
expected_observations: Field ownership and sub/sup slots follow §§1175–1177; duplicate diagnostics and help precede field-scan output.
postconditions: The first same-kind script remains attached once and later mlist order is intact.
equivalence_cases: Positive/boundary/nesting: absent nucleus, empty fields, both orders and nested choice/fraction fields
recovery_cases: A duplicate marker diagnoses Double subscript/superscript and redirects the new field to a dummy noad.

properties.claim: A generalized-fraction command freezes the current mlist as numerator, scans optional left/right delimiters and rule thickness into one fraction noad, then collects the denominator until fin_mlist; left opens a math-left group with its delimiter, right alone can close it, and mismatches recover by inserting the exact structural closer without corrupting either mlist.
preconditions: The current math list has no fraction noad yet or recovery can reject a duplicate.
Delimiter scans use live delcode/radical semantics and the save stack distinguishes math_shift, math, and math_left groups.
stimulus: Use over/atop/above and with-delimiters variants with empty/nonempty numerators/denominators and nested fractions; build nested left/middle/right groups and deliver missing, extra, or mismatched closers.
expected_observations: Numerator ownership transfers before denominator collection and default versus explicit thickness/delimiters remain distinct.
right finalizes the inner mlist and delimiter pair before appending one inner noad to its parent.
postconditions: Exactly one fraction noad owns its two mlists; exactly one left/right noad owns a balanced delimited sub-mlist.
The group/mode stack and following parent token are unchanged by successful completion beyond their canonical transitions.
equivalence_cases: Positive: all six generalized-fraction forms and left-right with null/growing delimiters.
Boundary: empty numerator/denominator, zero/default/negative thickness, delimiter 0/max, and duplicate fraction in one mlist.
Nesting/mode: fractions within scripts/choices/left-right and nested left-right groups preserve inner-first completion.
recovery_cases: A second generalized fraction is diagnosed and ignored without replacing the first numerator/state.
Missing right inserts frozen right-dot; extra/mismatched right takes off_save or mismatch recovery with the offending command replayed in order.

properties.claim: Math leaves only through after_math: it validates required symbol/extension font parameters, finishes any equation-number subformula, lowers inline math between boundary nodes or packages display math/equation number with TeX82 width, shrink, centering, displacement, skip and penalty decisions, then restores grouping and resumes the enclosing paragraph/page; display-alignment completion and its error context are owned separately by tex82.align.display-finish (§§1206–1207).
preconditions: A balanced math-shift group contains a finished mlist and optional equation-number mlist.
Live math fonts/parameters, display width/indent/skips/penalties, pre-display size/direction, and enclosing mode are available.
stimulus: Close empty/nonempty inline and display formulas with one/two shift lookahead, eqno/leqno of fitting/nonfitting widths, nested styles/boxes, missing font parameters, and display halign completion.
expected_observations: Inline exit appends math-on/hlist/math-off and restores hmode; display exit packages formula/eqno and selects above/below skips and penalties exactly from §§1198–1205.
The second closing shift is consumed only for display math; a nonshift lookahead is backed up and replayed.
postconditions: All math group levels and temporary mlists are retired once, enclosing mode resumes, and display contributions enter the vertical list in canonical order.
No lowering or diagnostic reads source tokens or changes frozen input observations.
equivalence_cases: Positive: inline/display empty and populated formulas, eqno/leqno, fitting shared-line and forced separate-line equations.
Boundary: absent symbol/extension font, zero display width, exact fit/shrink threshold, pre_display_size sentinel, and closing-shift lookahead.
Nesting/mode: inline math inside boxes/alignment cells, display after paragraph, and display alignment restore the proper enclosing list.
recovery_cases: Missing/invalid math font dimensions diagnose before packaging and leave no half-lowered list.
A single display-closing dollar inserts the required second dollar; an unexpected equation-number closer follows group-specific recovery.
